objective: Implement local full-text search, structured filtering, and deterministic report generation so the app can query records and produce reusable JSON and CSV outputs entirely from local data.
success_criteria: FTS indices exist for projects, tasks, meetings, raw captures, and people and stay synchronized with source tables through local database triggers.
Search returns grouped local results with snippets and supports combining text search with structured filters where applicable.
Structured filters cover project, OEM, worker, coordinator, project manager, task type, date range, and status.
Daily task list, project summary, and meeting minutes pack reports can be generated locally and emitted as in-app data plus JSON and CSV files.
Report generation is tracked in report_runs without introducing any network dependency.
stop_conditions: The task requires full PDF rendering or UI-shell work outside the current library package.
The task requires remote search infrastructure or hosted reporting.
The task requires changing canonical docs instead of implementing against them.
approval_gates: Introducing remote search or analytics services
Expanding report generation into network-backed exports
notes: Skip PDF generation for now; JSON and CSV are the required working outputs in this slice.
